item.title: Suspect allegedly confesses to killing 3 women found in Utah
item.description: Ivan Miller, 22, has been arrested and is in custody after authorities in Utah found three women's bodies in two locations.

item.title: 3/6: CBS Evening News
item.description: Russia helping Iran identify U.S. targets, sources say; Doctor adopts boy who came to surgery alone, then finds homes for his 5 siblings

item.title: Bodycam video contradicts ICE claims in fatal shooting of Ruben Ray Martinez
item.description: Video of last year's fatal shooting of Ruben Ray Martinez obtained by CBS News appears to contradict claims that Martinez was shot by an ICE agent because he "accelerated" and "intentionally ran over" another agent.

item.title: Rev. Jesse Jackson honored at Chicago celebration of life
item.description: The People's Celebration, allowed former presidents, family members, and more to honor the icon of the Civil Rights Movement.

item.title: The Firefighter's Secret
item.description: A young woman is found dead in her burning home. She'd been involved with a firefighter — could he have set a fire to cover her murder? "48 Hours" contributor Nikki Battiste reports.

item.title: The Sneak Attack on Katlyn Lyon
item.description: A mother goes viral on TikTok demanding justice for her murdered daughter. "48 Hours" correspondent Erin Moriarty reports.

item.description: Sources: Russia providing intelligence to Iran on U.S.; Sen. Blumenthal pushes for Kristi Noem perjury investigation

item.title: GOP Rep. Darrell Issa says he will retire, months after declaring he's "not quitting"
item.description: Rep. Darrell Issa's abrupt reversal injects more uncertainty in the race for the newly redrawn Southern California congressional district.

item.title: At least 4 dead after tornado rips through Michigan and storms hit central U.S.
item.description: Severe storms were sweeping across the central U.S., and forecasters warned tornadoes could turn dangerous across several states.

item.title: Trump demands "unconditional surrender" as Russia gives Iran intel on U.S. positions
item.description: With the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran in its eighth day, President Trump said the aim is to bring Iran back from the brink of destruction and "Make Iran Great Again."
